subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the focused fresh-session fix for accepted gateway disconnects, or should it pause until the broader reattach-first recovery design is chosen?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct for the duplicate same-session bug, but the remaining two-run and possible double-delivery behavior is an intentional user-visible fallback policy choice.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook boundary for this rare disconnect path and track reattach-first recovery separately in the open product issue.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first first
options.body: Pause this PR and require accepted disconnects to wait for the in-flight gateway result before any local fallback, trading more design work for fewer duplicate side effects.

options.title: Reject local fallback after acceptance
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers decide accepted gateway runs must never trigger a local recook path after disconnect.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook boundary for this rare disconnect path and track reattach-first recovery separately in the open product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is on CLI gateway fallback behavior, and recent history shows this person has carried adjacent gateway dispatch and timeout work.
